applyUnverifiedFactionRestrictions.description: Items marked 'demon?' are assumed to be demon-only. Unverified.

notes: slotTypes = descriptive sub-types (display/grouping). Five shared slots, max one copy per item, no extra limit per type. mutualExclusions: ["Item A", "Item B"] pairs not allowed together (empty).
seriesWaterNote: V0.182 official: Series weapons (Nightfall/Firstlight) keep their weapon effects after Whirl Pool, Water Wheel, Constant Flux, Dead Calm.
equipmentRule: 5 shared “Stats” slots for all wearable items (accessories, “Costume” outfits, “Clothing”: haori, tops, bottoms). No limit per type. Only one copy of each item can be worn, whatever its tier. Stats of distinct items add up (Illumination: only the highest counts).
gameRuleSource: CAM/Global/Series (OutfitPassives: Top + Bottom worn, tier >= PassiveTier 3)
seriesTierNote: Series items (Nightfall / Firstlight): stats × 1 / 1.15 / 1.3 by tier (T1 / T2 / T3). Refine only applies to RefineStats (Nightfall Top / Bottom: max HP only).
